title: DAN TIERNAN: QUARTZ AND ALL
description:
Dan Tiernan is back at it again: and this time he’s got magic rocks in his pocket.

With a hat trick of sold-out Edinburgh Festival runs, Dan's a two-time Edinburgh Comedy Award nominee who has received countless five-star reviews. No wonder The Guardian has named him 'one of comedy’s most distinctive new voices'.

‘Loud, inventive, visceral… it’s a blast’**** Times

Dan returns on tour armed with an amethyst, a bucketful of sage and a rose quartz the size of his impossibly large head.

As seen on Live at the Apollo, 8 Out of Ten Cats Does Countdown, The Last Leg, and QI.

NOMINEE: Best Newcomer – Edinburgh Comedy Awards 2023

NOMINEE: Best Comedy Show – Edinburgh Comedy Awards 2025

NOMINEE: Most Outstanding Show – Melbourne Comedy Awards 2026
subcategory: Wales Millennium Centre > What's on > 2027 > Dan Tiernan: Quartz And All

title: WELSH NATIONAL OPERA: JASON AND THE ARGONAUTS
description:
Get ready to embark on an adventure of magic and music with Jason and his fearless band of Argonauts in this thrilling retelling of a Greek classic.

Raised among nature and music in a magical forest, Jason longs to be a hero. When he discovers that his Uncle Pelias has stolen his place as King, he rushes to reclaim the throne. But King Pelias has one condition: Jason must bring him the Golden Fleece.

Joined by his team of Argonauts, they sail to Colchis, the home of the mystical fleece, but are met with dangerous dragons and sneaky sirens. Together they must be brave and clever and learn the true power of music. When faced with a huge challenge, will Jason make the right choice?

This action-packed production is a wonderful introduction to the world of opera for children, bringing to life the sounds of the orchestra and the power of the human voice. Filled with adventure, enchantment, and music, it’s an unforgettable experience for young audiences.

Recommended for children 7-12.

title: KEMAH BOB: LOVE CHILD
description:
Berk’s Nest, in association with Sophie Chapman Talent, presents Kemah Bob: Love ChildGiraffes. VHS porn. Ketamine-infused breast milk. Acclaimed stand-up Kemah Bob (The Guardian's 10 Best Comedy Shows of 2024) returns with her much anticipated second show.

Love Child is an intimate yet rowdy, personal yet electric, high-energy stand-up show from the “chest-achingly funny” (★★★★ Skinny) Kemah Bob. Join her on a hilariously unhinged tour through what it’s like to be a woman with your dad’s lips, a chaotic childhood with questionable parenting, the very real science of epigenetic baggage, and her attempts at navigating the relentless pressure to be a Good Grown Up™.

ISH Edinburgh Comedy Award Best Newcomer nominee 2024.

As seen on QI, Richard Osman's House of Games, Jonathan Ross' Comedy Club, Comedy Central Live, Don't Hate The Playaz and Guessable. As heard on the Off Menu podcast.

Directed by Alison Spittle.
subcategory: Wales Millennium Centre > What's on > 2027 > Kemah Bob: Love Child

title: MATTHEW BOURNE'S CINDERELLA
description:
London 1940. The Blackout. A siren sounds...

New Adventures return to Wales Millennium Centre with the 30th Anniversary celebration of one of their most popular and beloved productions, Matthew Bourne’s Cinderella – a thrilling and evocative love story, set in London during the Second World War.

Matthew Bourne’s epic interpretation of the classic fairytale, has, at its heart, a true war-time romance. A chance meeting results in a magical night for Cinderella and her dashing young RAF pilot, together just long enough to fall in love before being parted by the horrors of the Blitz.

With Lez Brotherston’s glorious Olivier Award-winning designs, lighting by Olivier Award-winning Neil Austin and video and projection designs by Duncan McLean, Cinderella features sensational sound design by Paul Groothuis which will take the audience into the heart of Prokofiev’s magnificent score, and the sights and sounds of war-torn London.

Cinderella is both a tribute and a testament to the spirit of London during a time when every second counted and lives were changed forever.  Bourne's vivid storytelling has never been more heart-stopping and touching, creating a unique and unforgettable depiction of a familiar but timeless fable.

title: BALLET MUSIC – STRAVINSKY & RAVEL
description:
DIALOGUE | SHARPNESS | ENCHANTMENT

Under the direction of Ludovic Morlot, this programme brings together three composers who reshaped musical language with imagination and originality.

Stravinsky’s dazzling ballet Jeu des cartes opens the concert with wit and rhythmic brilliance, spinning a sly narrative around the deceitful Joker in music of razor‑sharp invention.

At the heart of the evening is Britten’s youthful Double Concerto for Violin and Viola, written while still a student at the Royal College of Music. Performed by Ben Baker and Tim Ridout, the work reveals Britten’s unmistakable voice, from its striking horn‑like opening to its urgent dialogue between the soloists.

After the interval, Ravel’s enchanting Mother Goose Suite unfolds a world of fairy tales in glowing orchestral colour. Delicate, imaginative and richly evocative, it is a masterclass in musical storytelling and a magical close to the programme.

2 Jeu des cartes (23') Britten Double Concerto for Violin and Viola (20') IntervalRavel Mother Goose (30)'
subcategory: Wales Millennium Centre > What's on > 2027 > Ballet Music – Stravinsky & Ravel

title: MRS DOUBTFIRE
description:
Helloooo, poppets! Mrs Doubtfire, the West End's hit comedy musical based on the beloved film, is heading to Cardiff from 23 March 2027.

This ‘genuinely funny' (Time Out) show features all the iconic moments you love, plus fabulous new songs and dazzling dance numbers! Put it all together, and you've got a 'surefire hit' (The Telegraph, Daily Express) that can't be missed.

Out-of-work actor Daniel (played by the critically acclaimed Gabriel Vick* (original London company), will do anything for his kids. After losing custody in a messy divorce, he creates the alter ego of Scottish nanny Euphegenia Doubtfire in a desperate attempt to stay in their lives. As his new character takes on a life of its own, Mrs Doubtfire teaches Daniel more than he bargained for about how to be a father.

BOOK NOW, DEARS!

title: CELTIC BEETHOVEN
description:
ENERGY IDENTITY SONG

Marking 200 years since the death of Beethoven, this special concert celebrates the composer through his remarkable connections to the folk traditions of the British Isles. Conducted by Grant Llewellyn, with baritone Gwilym Bowen Rees piper Carlos Núñez Muñoz and harpist Catrin Finch, the programme highlights Beethoven’s fascination with Irish, Scottish and Welsh melodies. Songs such as The Vale of Clwyd, The Return to Ulster and The Pulse of an Irishman reveal how deeply he valued folk music as a source of authenticity and emotional truth. These settings combine simple, expressive melodies with Beethoven’s unmistakable craftsmanship. A specially arranged performance of the Welsh lullaby Suo Gân sits alongside Scottish and Irish airs and variations. The concert opens with the electrifying finale of Symphony No. 7, whose rhythmic vitality offers a powerful tribute to Beethoven’s enduring legacy and human spirit.

Artists-

Grant Llewellyn - Conductor Gwilym Bowen Rhys  - Baritone Carlos Núñez Muñoz – Pipes  Catrin Finch – Harp

The five star comedy sensation from the West End

A triumph in the West End, where it won the Laurence Olivier Award for Best Comedy and the Evening Standard Award, Pride and Prejudice* (*sort of) is a unique and audacious retelling of Jane Austen’s most iconic love story.

Men, money and microphones will be fought over in this irreverent but affectionate adaptation where the stakes couldn’t be higher when it comes to romance. This multi-award-winning production features a string of pop classics including Young Hearts Run Free, Will You Love Me Tomorrow and You’re So Vain.

IT’S THE 1800S. IT’S PARTY TIME. LET THE RUTHLESS MATCHMAKING BEGIN.

title: RHAPSODY IN BLUE
description:
CONNECTION JAZZ FIRE

This vibrant programme brings together music of dialogue, city energy and sun‑drenched dance under the direction of Carlos Miguel Prieto. Gabriela Ortiz’s TZAM, meaning “dialogue” in the endangered Ayapaneco language, opens the evening with a powerful reflection on human connection, memory and shared space. Dedicated to the late composer Mario Lavista, the work invites listeners into an urgent and contemplative musical conversation. Ethan Loch is soloist in Gershwin’s iconic Rhapsody in Blue, a work born from the rhythms of the American city and famously conceived on a train journey. Jazzy, virtuosic and unmistakably American, it remains a dazzling musical kaleidoscope. After the interval, Manuel de Falla’s full ballet The Three‑Cornered Hat closes the concert in brilliant colour, blending Spanish folk rhythms with luminous orchestration in a theatrical score of irresistible vitality.

title: DISNEY PRINCESS - THE CONCERT
description:
For generations, the music of Disney’s princesses has been the soundtrack to our lives. Now, these beloved songs come alive on stage with a host of acclaimed Broadway and West End stars in Disney Princess – The Concert.

Your every dream will come true as larger-than-life animation and theatrical effects immerse the audience in pure Disney magic, while these powerhouse talents sing your favourite princess, hero and (yes!) villain songs, and share behind-the-scenes stories from their time on the stage and screen.

We invite you to relive your VHS glory days, dress up in your favourite royal attire, and share the joy of Disney with your loved ones at this internationally acclaimed concert experience. Be part of our world at Disney Princess – The Concert!

Disney Princess – The Concert has played 20 countries on 5 continents since its premiere in 2021, including two US tours of more than 100 cities, and tours the UK and Ireland for the first time in 2027.

The show features iconic songs from more than 29 films, including: “How Far I’ll Go,” “A Whole New World,” “Just Around the Riverbend,” “Part of Your World,” “Almost There,” “Let It Go” and more!

Cast of Disney Broadway and West End talent to be announced in August.

description:

Don’t take our word for it, take Bob Geldof’s who says it’s “f***ing phenomenal”.

40 years on from the iconic gig that re-wrote music history, relive the joy of Live Aid in a “completely new and delightful way!” (Pete Townshend of The Who).

title: GRACE – ASTRAL ILLUMINATIONS
description:
WONDER | MEMORY | RADIANCE

Conductor Chloe Rooke leads an immersive programme inspired by orbiting worlds, imagined landscapes and folk memory, with Laura van der Heijden as soloist.

Missy Mazzoli’s Sinfonia (for Orbiting Spheres) opens the concert in restless motion, its looping figures circling like a living solar system. The first half culminates in the world premiere of Augusta Read Thomas’s Cello Concerto, Astral Illuminations, music of radiant colour and lyric intensity that celebrates the expressive voice of the cello.

After the interval, Grace Williams’s Dark Island Suite evokes rugged seascapes, followed by Grace‑Evangeline Mason’s The Imagined Forest, a surreal, collage‑like journey through fantastical terrain inspired by visual art and folklore. The concert closes with Ester Mägi’s Symphony, rooted in Estonian folk tradition and shaped by a lifetime of deep musical reflection, bringing this richly atmospheric programme to a powerful conclusion.

Missy Mazzoli Sinfonia (for Orbiting Spheres) (10’) Augusta Read Thomas Astral Illuminations, New Cello Concerto [World Premiere] (25’) IntervalWilliams Dark Island Suite (c10’) Grace-Evangeline Mason The Imagined Forest (15') Ester Mägi Symphony (14’)

title: LANG LANG
description:
Lang Lang is a leading figure in classical music today – as a pianist, educator, and philanthropist, he has become one of the world’s most influential and committed ambassadors for the arts in the 21st century.

Equally happy playing for billions of viewers at the 2008 Olympic Opening Ceremony in Beijing, the 2020 Dubai EXPO Opening Ceremony, the 2024 Reopening of Notre Dame in Paris, or just for a few hundred children in public schools, he is a master of communicating through music.

Heralded by the New York Times as “the hottest artist on the classical music planet,” Lang Lang plays sold-out concerts all over the world. He has formed ongoing collaborations with conductors including Sir Simon Rattle, Gustavo Dudamel, Daniel Barenboim, and Christoph Eschenbach, and performs with all the world’s top orchestras. Lang Lang is known for thinking outside the box and frequently steps into different musical worlds. Millions of viewers watched his performances at the GRAMMY Awards with Metallica, Pharrell Williams, and jazz legend Herbie Hancock.

For about a decade, Lang Lang has contributed to musical education worldwide. In 2008, he founded the Lang Lang International Music Foundation, aimed at cultivating tomorrow’s top pianists, championing music education at the forefront of technology, and building a young audience through live music experiences. In 2013, Lang Lang was designated by the Secretary-General of the United Nations as a Messenger of Peace, focusing on global education.

Lang Lang started playing the piano at age three and gave his first public recital before the age of five. At age nine, he entered Beijing’s Central Music Conservatory and won First Prize at the International Tchaikovsky Competition for Young Musicians at 13. He subsequently went to Philadelphia to study with legendary pianist Gary Graffman at the Curtis Institute of Music. He was seventeen when his big break came, substituting for André Watts at the Gala of the Century, playing Tchaikovsky’s First Piano Concerto with the Chicago Symphony Orchestra under the baton of Christoph Eschenbach: he became an overnight sensation, and the invitations started to pour in.

Lang Lang’s boundless drive to attract new audiences to classical music has brought him tremendous recognition: he was presented with the 2010 Crystal Award in Davos and was picked as one of the 250 Young Global Leaders by the World Economic Forum. He is also the recipient of honorary doctorates from the Royal College of Music, the Manhattan School of Music, and New York University. In December 2011, he was honored with the highest prize awarded by the Ministry of Culture of the People’s Republic of China and received the highest civilian honors in Germany (Merit of the Federal Republic of Germany) and France (Medal of the Order of Arts and Letters). In 2016, Lang Lang was invited to the Vatican to perform for Pope Francis. He has also performed for numerous other international dignitaries, including four U.S. presidents and monarchs from many nations.

title: THE CURIOUS INCIDENT OF THE DOG IN THE NIGHT-TIME
description:
The century's most popular murder mystery.

The internationally celebrated novel that captivated 10 million readers is coming in a brand-new staging more thrilling than ever.

Chris Boone is gifted with a brilliant mind for numbers but unsettled by the unpredictability of people and everyday life. When a neighbour’s dog is discovered killed, she finds herself under suspicion. Determined to prove her innocence, Chris becomes both detective and suspect, drawn into a mystery that grows darker and more complex with every clue she uncovers.

What begins as the search for a culprit soon reveals secrets closer to home, forcing her to confront truths that will test her courage, her family, and her understanding of trust, independence, and the wider world.

Starring Joe McFadden (The Shawshank Redemption - UK Tour; 2:22 A Ghost Story – Gielgud Theatre; Strictly Come Dancing winner 2017) and EastEnders favourite Charlie Brooks (Chitty Chitty Bang Bang - UK Tour; Ocean at the End of the Lane - National Theatre) as Chris’ parents - Ed and Judy.Inventive, gripping, and moving, The Curious Incident of the Dog in the Night-Time combines the intrigue of a whodunnit with a powerful coming-of-age story in an unforgettable theatrical event.

title: GREASE
description:
The world’s best-loved musical is back! Grittier and more glamorous than ever before.

After a whirlwind summer romance, leather-clad greaser Danny and girl-next-door Sandy are unexpectedly reunited when she transfers to Rydell High for senior year. But can they survive the trials and tribulations of teenage life and find true love once more?

With its phenomenal score, bursting with hits including Summer Nights, Greased Lightnin’, Hopelessly Devoted to You and You’re the One That I Want, this thrilling new version is brought to life by a fresh young cast who bring energy, vitality and passion to this ultimate musical classic.

Directed by Curve’s Artistic Director Nikolai Foster reignite your passion and get ready for an explosion of summer loving.

So round-up your Burger Palace Boys, pick up your Pink Ladies and re-discover why Grease really is the one that you want this term!

Book, Music & Lyrics by Jim Jacobs & Warren Casey. Directed by Nikolai Foster. Choreography by Arlene Phillips.
subcategory: Wales Millennium Centre > What's on > 2027 > Grease

title: STRAUSS & BRUCKNER
description:
From hushed contemplation to radiant choral power, an arc of transformation unfolds.

Conducted by Alpesh Chauhan, we open with 1001 by Icelandic composer and violinist María Huld Markan Sigfúsdóttir, a work of luminous colour and subtle intensity. Strauss’s Metamorphosen, composed in the final months of the Second World War, follows as a deeply personal meditation on loss and renewal, its unfolding lines charged with quiet emotional weight. After the interval, we are joined by the BBC National Chorus of Wales for Bruckner’s monumental Mass No. 2 in E minor. Written for eight-part chorus and wind ensemble, the Mass fuses Renaissance-inspired purity with Bruckner’s unmistakable harmonic richness, creating music of profound devotion, restraint, and power.
subcategory: Wales Millennium Centre > What's on > 2027 > Strauss & Bruckner

title: HEDD WYN: EISTEDDFOD ATOMIG
description:
Trawsfynydd, 2117.

200 years after the death of Welsh poet Hedd Wyn, a group of pilgrims return to Trawsfynydd - now an abandoned exclusion zone following a catastrophic failure at the nearby nuclear power station - to reconnect with their Welsh heritage.

Expecting a commemorative tour of Hedd Wyn’s ancestral home, they instead step into a fractured landscape where radiation has blurred time itself. Past, present and future collide and the ghosts of history and legend walk alongside the small utopian community that remains.

Guided by the strange survivors of the disaster, the group venture deeper into their ancestry and the very heart of Welsh mythology, as conflicting visions for the future of Wales begin to emerge. and Hedd Wyn’s legacy is reshaped and distorted in pursuit of a dangerous new beginning.

From the imagination of Gruff Rhys, with music by Stephen McNeff and directed by Steffan Donnelly, Hedd Wyn: Eisteddfod Atomig is a haunting new opera which explores how the poet’s story can be misrepresented, mythologised and reclaimed. It asks who gets to decide what his legacy means for Wales today?

title: BBC NOW SURROUND SOUND
description:
IMMERSION | MOVEMENT | PRESENCE

Sound is never still in this performance; it drifts, pulses and gathers around you.

Conceived by Daniel Pioro, the concert invites listeners to move freely through the space: to walk, change seats, or sit among the musicians as the music unfolds. The focus is not on passive listening, but on presence — on how sound is felt as much as heard. Steve Reich’s Duet for Two Violins and Strings opens the programme, with Pioro and BBC National Orchestra of Wales Leader Lesley Hatfield as soloists, its shifting patterns precise yet mesmerising. Music by pioneering electronic composer Daphne Oram deepens the sense of exploration, while Terry Riley’s iconic In C forms the centrepiece — a living, breathing work that reconfigures itself with every moment.

title: CATS
description:
A NEW DAY HAS BEGUN.

A spectacular new production of Andrew Lloyd Webber’s multi award-winning musical CATS is coming to Wales Millennium Centre.

From Euston station to Victoria Grove, the strays and rebels of London gather under the Jellicle moon in the hope they’ll be the chosen one. And each of them asks, because each of them dares, who will it be?

Based on T.S. Eliot’s Old Possum’s Book of Practical Cats, and with a legendary score which inspired generations featuring, Old Deuteronomy, Macavity: The Mystery Cat, Jellicle Ball and the chart-topping hit Memory, this brand-new production of CATS, directed and choreographed by Drew McOnie (Brigadoon, Jesus Christ Superstar) arrives 25 May 2027 for 1 week only.

Michael Harrison for Lloyd Webber Harrison Musicals presents this Regent’s Park Open Air Theatre production. By arrangement with LW Entertainment.

title: EVERYBODY'S TALKING ABOUT JAMIE
description:
Following a record-breaking three-year West End residency, two sold-out UK & Ireland Tours and Amazon Studios award-winning film, the smash-hit and critically acclaimed musical Everybody’s Talking About Jamie RETURNS for the 10th Anniversary Tour with a brand-new song.

Jamie New (Ashcon Rahmani) is sixteen and lives on a council estate in Sheffield. Jamie doesn’t quite fit in. Jamie is terrified about the future. Jamie is going to be a sensation.

Supported by his brilliant loving mum (Rebecca Trehearn) and surrounded by his friends, Jamie over comes prejudice, beats the bullies and steps out of the darkness, into the spotlight. This ‘Funny, outrageous, touching’ (Daily Telegraph), musical sensation is to be experienced by all the family and not to be missed!

With an original score of catchy pop tunes that will ‘blow the roof off the Theatre’ (Mail on Sunday) by lead singer-songwriter of The Feeling, Dan Gillespie Sells and writer Tom MacRae (Doctor Who), this ‘Sparkling coming-of-age musical’ (The Times) will have everybody talking about Jamie for years to come.

Sixteen: the edge of possibility. Time to make your dreams come true.

title: PRETTY WOMAN
description:
Big night out. Big. HUGE.

Pretty Woman: The Musical is coming back to Cardiff. It’s time to head to Beverly Hills and experience one of Hollywood’s most iconic romantic comedies of all time. This ‘dazzling new stage show’ (Daily Express) takes to the road again in 2027 following a record-breaking run in the West End and a sell-out first UK tour in 2023.

Vivian and Edward are unlikely soulmates who overcome all odds to find each other… and themselves. Experience the moments you love from the movie - and get to know these iconic characters in a whole new way - in this dazzlingly joyous love story for the ages.

Brought to life by a powerhouse creative team representing the best of music, Hollywood and Broadway, Pretty Woman: The Musical features direction and choreography by two-time Tony Award® winner Jerry Mitchell (Kinky Boots, Legally Blonde, Hairspray), an original ‘blazing rock score’ (Daily Mail) score by Grammy® winner Bryan Adams and Jim Vallance (‘Summer of ’69’, ‘Heaven’) and a book by the movie’s legendary director Garry Marshall and screenwriter J.F. Lawton.

Fall in love with Hollywood’s ultimate feel-good fairytale, live on stage when it comes to Wales Millennium Centre in June 2027.
subcategory: Wales Millennium Centre > What's on > 2027 > Pretty Woman

title: BEETHOVEN 9
description:
HERITAGE | UNITY | LEGACY

A bold contemporary voice meets one of the greatest symphonic landmarks in an evening led by Principal Guest Conductor Jaime Martin, marking 200 years since the death of Beethoven.

James MacMillan’s Concerto for Orchestra – Ghosts, opens the programme: a continuous, through‑composed work alive with shifting memories, folk echoes and spectral allusions. Chamber groupings surface from the orchestral fabric before resolving in a serene, hymn‑like close. After the interval comes Beethoven’s monumental Symphony No. 9, a work that redefined the symphony itself. Its revolutionary choral finale unites orchestra, chorus and an outstanding quartet of soloists, Gweneth‑Ann Rand, Anna Stéphany, Ryan Vaughan Davies and Blaise Malaba, all former Cardiff Singer of the World performers, in music of immense power and uplifting joy.

Macmillan Concerto for Orchestra (25') Interval (20') Beethoven Symphony No.9 (65')

title: JOHANNES RADEBE: FINALLY HOME
description:
Johannes Radebe is back!

2026 has been an extraordinary year for JoJo. He has become a British citizen, made his West End debut and started his dream role as presenter of Strictly Come Dancing. But one thing will never change: Johannes was born to dance.

In his brand-new dance spectacular Finally Home, you are invited to an unforgettable evening packed with dazzling choreography, show-stopping vocals, stunning costumes and the infectious energy that has made him one of the nation's most beloved stars.

With musical influences ranging from ballroom standards, South African rhythms and the biggest pop anthems, Finally Home is your chance to celebrate with JoJo at the biggest party in town.

title: HADESTOWN
description:
Welcome to Hadestown - 'Your next musical theatre obsession' Vogue

The smash-hit Broadway and West End musical sensation by singer-songwriter Anaïs Mitchell and director Rachel Chavkin is heading out on its first ever UK and Ireland Tour.

‘Big, beautiful and emotionally blasting’ (The Guardian), Hadestown is the winner of 8 Tony Awards including Best Musical and the Grammy Award® for Best Musical Theatre Album. Seen by over six million, streamed by nearly a billion and adored by fans around the world, this record-breaking musical is ‘the most exhilarating ride’ (WhatsOnStage).

Hadestown takes you on an unforgettable journey to the underworld and back, intertwining two ancient Greek mythic love stories – that of young dreamers Orpheus and Eurydice, and that of King Hades and his wife Persephone.

A deeply resonant and defiantly hopeful theatrical experience, Hadestown invites you to imagine how the world could be.

Get your HADESTOWN tickets now and experience the musical phenomenon that’s taken the world by storm.

title: WEST SIDE STORY
description:
ELEGANCE | PULSE | PLAYFULNESS

Elegance, energy and irresistible rhythm shape this vibrant programme conducted by Samuel Lee.

Ravel’s Pavane pour une infante défunte opens the evening with poised melancholy, its flowing lines and refined orchestral colours offering a moment of quiet reflection.

At the heart of the concert is a world premiere: Salina Fisher’s Violin Concerto, written for and performed by Geneva Lewis. Drawing on Fisher’s distinctive lyrical voice and Lewis’s expressive virtuosity, the concerto blends clarity, urgency and luminous colour, placing the violin at the centre of an unfolding, contemporary sound world.

After the interval, Poulenc’s playful Les Biches Suite sparkles with charm and wit, before the orchestra launches into Bernstein’s West Side Story: Symphonic Dances. Pulsing with jazz-inflected rhythms, sweeping melodies and explosive energy, it brings the programme to a thrilling, high-spirited close.

title: IT'S A SIN
description:
Rambert’s new dance work It’s a Sin, inspired by the acclaimed series by Russell T Davies, directed and choreographed by Artistic Director Benoit Swan Pouffer.

Joy as resistance. Love as survival.

In the heart of 80s London, Ritchie, Roscoe, Colin and Jill are chasing identity, connection and a life on their own terms. When day spills into night, they find a world of abandon, music and friendship, where bodies move freely and life feels limitless.

But as the AIDS crisis begins to unfold, their lives are irrevocably changed. Love, fear and defiance collide as they fight for each other in a world that is rapidly shifting around them — and increasingly hostile to their existence.

Brought to life by Rambert’s extraordinary dancers, It’s a Sin weaves past and present into something raw, visceral and devastating — an epic story told through movement, asking who gets remembered, who gets left behind, and how we choose to live now.

It’s a Sin is made possible thanks to major support from the Colwinston Charitable Trust’s 30th Anniversary Fund. It’s a Sin has been supported by Incentivising Touring: Repayable Grants for Theatre and Dance, a pilot scheme developed by Arts Council England to support mid-large scale productions to tour to regional venues. It’s a Sin was amongst the 23 to receive a share of over £4.5 million across two investment rounds of the scheme, which creates the opportunity for more people to see high-quality shows close to where they live.

Presented by Rambert and Factory International. Co-produced with Wales Millennium Centre (Cardiff), Capital Theatres (Edinburgh), Sadler’s Wells (London), and Les Théâtres de la Ville (Luxembourg).

Executive Producers: Russell T Davies, Pet Shop Boys, Glyn Fussell

This production is inspired by the television series “It’s a Sin” created by Russell T Davies and produced by Red Production Company
subcategory: Wales Millennium Centre > What's on > 2027 > It's A Sin

title: FLEETWOOD MAC'S 'RUMOURS' WITH THE TRANSATLANTIC ENSEMBLE
description:
The 'Transatlantic Ensemble' return by popular demand to Wales Millenium Centre, after past sellout shows here three years in a row and multiple sell-outs at Edinburgh Fringe Festival and right across the UK.

They will be performing Fleetwood Mac's iconic Rumours album in its entirety, plus loads of other well-known Fleetwood Mac classics. Experience one of the greatest albums of all time, lovingly and accurately recreated live, by this stunning ensemble of gifted young musicians and vocalists.

There is just something so evocative about the Rumours album – something that strikes a chord with every true music fan. It has soundtracked the lives of multiple generations.

Ask anyone who saw them here at any of their previous shows, if you are a fan of the album, this stunning performance by this incredible ensemble is quite simply something you cannot afford to miss. Be sure to bring your singing voice and prepare to be amazed, as this band are quite simply phenomenal!

title: HAIRSPRAY
description:
You can’t stop OUR beat - HAIRSPRAY is BACK ON TOUR - so run and tell that!

Neil Hurst (Hairspray, The Full Monty) returns to reprise the iconic role of Edna Turnblad with further casting to be announced.

Hairspray took Broadway by storm, winning 8 Tony awards. The production went on to win 4 Olivier awards in the West End, and multiple awards worldwide. This feel-good classic is back.

Featuring some of musical theatre’s biggest hit songs, Welcome to the 60s, You Can’t Stop the Beat, Good Morning Baltimore and many more. Hairspray is the hilarious, joyous, and inspiring musical for all!

Join big hearted Tracy Turnblad and her new friends the spirited Seaweed and his sister Little Inez, heartthrob Link Larkin and the resolute Motormouth Maybelle as they strive to change the world. Hairspray has wowed audiences in The West End and on Broadway and still packs a punch with its message of tolerance and the fight against racism.

This family fun-filled show is bursting with show-stopping numbers and dizzying dance routines, come and join the beat because just to sit still would be a crime!

UK Tour from July 2027 - BOOK NOW!
subcategory: Wales Millennium Centre > What's on > 2027 > Hairspray

title: BACK TO THE FUTURE
description:
Great Scott, Cardiff– the DeLorean is coming your way!

Strap in for the smash hit Back to the Future The Musical, landing at Wales Millennium Centre as part of its first ever UK tour with rising Australian star Axel Duffy returning as Marty McFly. Winner of Best New Musical at the Olivier Awards, WhatsOnStage Awards and Broadway World Awards, this “perfect musical escapism” (Metro) is ready to take you on an electrifying journey through time.

Based on the iconic 1985 movie and brought to the stage by the film’s original creators Bob Gale and Robert Zemeckis, this multi-award-winning production is dazzling critics and thrilling audiences across the globe – and now it’s Cardiff’s turn to experience the ride of a lifetime.

When teenager Marty McFly is accidentally sent back to 1955 in a time machine built by the eccentric Doc Brown, he disrupts the space-time continuum and must race against the clock to put things right – and get back to the future.

Don’t miss this “high-voltage comedy” (Metro) and “feelgood triumph” (Telegraph), directed by Tony Award-winner John Rando and featuring a show-stopping DeLorean that “defies the laws of theatre” (Guardian).

Back to the Future the Musical features original music by multi-Grammy winners Alan Silvestri (Avengers: Endgame) and Glen Ballard (Michael Jackson’s Man in the Mirror), alongside hit songs from the movie including The Power of Love, Johnny B. Goode, Earth Angel and Back in Time.

“It’s a total blast” (Metro), and when this baby hits 88mph at Wales Millennium Centre, it will zap “the audience between the eyes and ears to a roar of delight” (Variety).

Book your tickets yesterday.
subcategory: Wales Millennium Centre > What's on > 2027 > Back To The Future

title: Fun For Little Ones - A Tribute To Ms Rachel
description: Book your tickets to Fun For Little Ones - A Tribute To Ms Rachel at New Theatre Cardiff at the official Trafalgar Tickets, New Theatre Cardiff box office.
shortDescription:
🎉 A Must-See Live Show for Little Ones! 🎉
The UK’s Ultimate Tribute to the Global Sensation… Ms Rachel! Get ready for singing, dancing, giggles and non-stop fun as the magic of Ms Rachel comes to life on stage in an interactive, high-energy live tribute performance made just just for little ones and their grownups! With over ten billion views and fifteen million YouTube subscribers, Ms Rachel is the viral superstar capturing hearts across the world — and now, your little ones can experience this FUN, interactive LIVE on stage performance! 🌟 Fun for Little Ones Live is the UK’s only tribute show of its kind, bursting with: ✨ Lively sing-alongs and engaging songs 🎵 Live on stage Ms Rachel Tribute & her dancing friends! 🎭 Puppets, characters, and colourful on-screen animations 🎤 Audience participation and educational moments 🎬 Magical screen content with Monty & Friends Whether they’re clapping, dancing, or singing their hearts out, children will be enchanted from start to finish! 💥 Don’t miss your chance to be part of the excitement - families across the UK are raving, and little fans are going wild! 🎟️ Book your tickets now – it's the show every toddler (and their grown-up) is talking about!

title: GK Barry: It's Giving Life
description: She’s hilarious, honest and completely unfiltered
shortDescription:
Join GK Barry this September as she celebrates the release of her new book, It’s Giving Life, with an unmissable live tour packed full of laughs, oversharing, and some life advice (taken with a very big pinch of salt). From TikTok fame to becoming a breakout star on I'm a Celebrity...Get Me Out of Here! and a regular panelist on Loose Women, GK Barry has become one of the most influential and relatable young voices in British media. With over 5 million followers across social media and a chart-topping podcast, Saving Grace, her rise has been nothing short of iconic. Now, she’s bringing that same energy to the stage. Expect outrageous stories, brutally honest confessions, and the kind of chaotic commentary that made her a household name. From dating disasters and digital drama to body image, sexuality, personal traumas and all the questionable decisions in between, nothing is off-limits. This is GK Barry at her finest. Live, unfiltered, and oversharing for the greater good of humanity. This intimate evening is likely to sell out, so do not miss your chance for a hilarious night out and book today! Come for the chaos. Stay for the laughs. Leave feeling better about your own life choices.

Meet & Greet tickets include a signed copy of It's Giving Life

title: Jeremy Bowen: Truth Under Fire
description: Book your tickets to Jeremy Bowen: Truth Under Fire at New Theatre Cardiff at the official Trafalgar Tickets, New Theatre Cardiff box office.
shortDescription: Gaza. Ukraine. Syria. Sudan. Yemen. The world is facing more armed conflicts than at any point in decades, and Jeremy Bowen has reported from the centre of nearly all of them.  As the BBC's International Editor, Jeremy has spent over 40 years covering more than 90 countries and 20 wars. From El Salvador in 1989 to the frontlines today, he has interviewed world leaders, documented war crimes, been shot at, and survived to tell the stories.  But something has changed. Israel imposes restrictions on foreign journalists from entering Gaza. Russia controls the narrative in occupied Ukraine. Governments from Syria to Sudan restrict access, manipulate information, and discredit reporters who contradict official accounts. In the age of social media, competing claims flood our screens, but who is telling the truth? And how do we know?  Jeremy has spent his career fighting for access, verifying what others want hidden, and bearing witness when governments would rather the world look away. He will explain how the battle for truth is being waged, why press freedom is collapsing in conflict zones, and what it means when the first casualty of war is not just truth, but those trying to report it.  In the second half, audiences will have the chance to put their questions to a journalist who has made it his life's work to get as close to the truth as possible—even when that truth is dangerous, disputed, or under fire.  An essential evening for anyone who wants to understand the world as it is, not as we wish it to be

title: Prof Alice Roberts – From Cell to Civilisation
description: Book your tickets to Prof Alice Roberts – From Cell to Civilisation  at New Theatre Cardiff at the official Trafalgar Tickets, New Theatre Cardiff box office.
shortDescription:
A Lateral Events Production:
Prof Alice Roberts – From Cell to Civilisation
Humankind, genetics, and archaeology
A new, groundbreaking, spectacular theatrical production live on stage

Prof Alice Roberts said “I’m thrilled to be bringing a new stage show to the UK in November exploring the story of us, from Cell to Civilisation. 

Blending archaeology, evolutionary biology and genetics and using theatrical sound, light and imagination to bring the science to life in a way that you’ve never seen before.

We’ll be tracing our origins back, not just to the dawn of our own species, but to the origin of life on this planet. That’s four billion years of evolution in one evening.

I’m really excited about this, I’ve taken this show to Australia, to Canada, and now it’s coming to the UK in November. I can’t wait to share this story with you.”

Who are we? Where do we come from? What does it mean to be human?

For thousands of years, such questions have been explored through philosophy and religion, but the answers now seem to lie firmly within the grasp of an empirical approach to the world and our place within it. By peering deep into our past and dragging clues out into the light, science can now provide us with some of the answers to the questions that people have always asked.

From the first spark of life on earth 3.8 billion years ago, we track the evolution and connectivity of all living things.

Join us as we follow in the footsteps of our ancestors from Africa into Asia and around the Indian coastline, to Australia, north into Europe and Siberia, and, eventually, to the last continents to be peopled: the Americas. We’ll meet some other human species along the way.

We’ll examine the sophistication of some of the earliest civilisations, and we’ll discuss how we know what we know and why we think what we think, what the science can tell us.

This is the story of us, from single cell to civilisation. Approx. finish time of 10:15pm.
subcategory: Trafalgar Tickets > New Theatre > What's On > Special Events > Prof Alice Roberts – From Cell to Civilisation

His voice, presence, and raw authenticity don’t just imitate Cash — they ignite him. Every note. Every story. Every iconic move. It’s powerful, spine‑tingling, and utterly unforgettable.

Together, they’re backed by a powerhouse lineup of world‑class musicians delivering the unmistakable boom‑chicka‑boom like a runaway train. 

This isn’t just a tribute — it’s a high‑octane celebration of Cash, bringing his outlaw spirit, with all his hits including Folsom Prison and Cocaine Blues and this year the roaring legacy of the American Supergroup The Highwaymen with hits such as Highwayman and Silver Stallion and mamas don't let your babies grow up to be cowboys. Expect a sensational rendition of Hurt,  warm soulful nostalgic songs such as Walk the Line and Daddy Sang Bass, incorporating all the hits and finishing with the unforgettable classic Ring of Fire.

Every performance erupts in standing ovations — every night, every venue, every crowd swept to their feet by the power, passion, and unstoppable energy of this phenomenal show. 

**This is the Man in Black as you’ve never experienced him. 

This is the outlaw revival of the decade. 
This is the Johnny Cash Roadshow — keeping the legend alive, louder and stronger than ever.** 

Grab your tickets. Hold on tight. 
And get ready for the ride of your life.

description: Book your tickets to Ukrainian National Opera: Tosca at New Theatre Cardiff at the official Trafalgar Tickets, New Theatre Cardiff box office.
shortDescription: Music by Giacomo Puccini Sung in Italian with English Surtitles Set against the magnificent backdrop of Rome, Puccini's Tosca is one of the most thrilling and dramatic operas ever written. Combining romance, political intrigue and extraordinary music, it remains one of the most popular works in the operatic repertoire and one of the greatest nights out in live theatre. The opera follows the celebrated singer Floria Tosca and her lover, the artist Mario Cavaradossi, as they are drawn into a dangerous world of suspicion, corruption and control. When Cavaradossi becomes involved with an escaped political prisoner, both lovers fall into the hands of the ruthless Baron Scarpia, a man determined to possess Tosca and destroy anyone who stands in his way. As jealousy, passion and power collide, Tosca is forced to make an impossible choice between love and survival. The result is a gripping story of sacrifice, betrayal and destiny, building towards one of the most unforgettable finales in all opera. Puccini's score is a masterpiece of theatrical intensity, filled with soaring melody, dramatic orchestral writing and moments of extraordinary emotional power. Featuring the immortal aria Vissi d'arte, Tosca offers some of the most passionate and memorable music ever composed. This spectacular production by the Dnipro Opera features lavish costumes, impressive sets, outstanding international soloists and the full richness of a live orchestra, bringing Puccini's masterpiece vividly to life. A thrilling evening of romance, suspense and unforgettable music.

title: The Silence Of The Lambs
description: The iconic psychological thriller
shortDescription:
A WORLD STAGE PREMIERE 
Dr Hannibal Lecter will see you now…  Come face to face with the chilling cultural phenomenon The Silence of the Lambs as it makes its world stage play premiere. Based on Thomas Harris’s gripping literary masterpiece, this electrifying new play sets the definitive psychological thriller loose in Cardiff.  Starring John Partridge (EastEnders, Cabaret) as Hannibal Lecter, Mollie Gallagher (Coronation Street) as Clarice Starling, Oliver Farnworth (Emmerdale) as Agent Jack Crawford, and Sam Jackson (Skins) as Buffalo Bill, this gripping new production brings these iconic characters terrifyingly close.  When FBI trainee Clarice Starling is sent to interview the psychiatrist and infamous murderer Hannibal Lecter, it’s hoped his brilliant mind will help catch a sadistic new serial killer, Buffalo Bill. Another girl is missing, and time is running out. But Dr Lecter has questions of his own, and now Clarice must decide: keep a safe distance, or let Hannibal ‘The Cannibal’ into her head…?  Written by the award-winning Gina Gionfriddo and directed by the acclaimed Nikolai Foster, The Silence of the Lambs drips with tension and gets you closer than ever to the iconic thrills and terrifyingly memorable characters of the landmark novel.  The Clock is ticking. Hunt down a ticket and book now…  Before it’s too late.  Please note this production contains disturbing scenes of threats, violence and murder, very strong language, onstage prosthetic human remains, sexual references, sexual harassment and violence, flashing lights, haze and loud noises (including gunshots). Age guidance is 15+. Running time:  2 hours 15 minutes (including a 20 minute interval)

title: Tap Factory
description: Book your tickets to Tap Factory  at New Theatre Cardiff at the official Trafalgar Tickets, New Theatre Cardiff box office.
shortDescription:
After thrilling audiences across five continents with over 900 shows, Tap Factory is back in the UK, now in its Reloaded version: bigger, bolder, and more spectacular than ever! Witness eight extraordinary performers pushing the limits of dance, acrobatics, music, and comedy in a reimagined production. With brand-new scenery, evolved choreography, and jaw-dropping stunts, this high-octane show will ignite your senses like never before. Feel the pulse of explosive percussion, experience new generation tap, marvel at breathtaking acrobatics, and laugh out loud as live music collides with electrifying performance. Fast, furious, and funnier than ever, Tap Factory is a dazzling spectacle for the whole family! 
Directed by Vincent PAUSANIAS

title: Murder Trial Tonight V: Death In The Family
description: Murder Trial Tonight returns after four previous sold-out seasons with its most gripping case yet.
shortDescription: Murder Trial Tonight V: Death in the Family brings a chilling true story that shocked the world to the stage. A devoted mother and wife is found murdered in her own kitchen - and a member of her own family stands accused. In this immersive courtroom experience, you become part of the jury. Watch and listen as the prosecution and defence present every twist, every argument, and every piece of evidence. Then, it’s your turn to decide. Cast your verdict live via QR code and help determine the outcome But the real question is - did you get it right? Once the audience verdict is in, the truth behind the real-life case is revealed on the big screen. Prepare for a night of tension, drama, and moral dilemma where every decision counts. Warning: Contains disturbing content and imagery related to murder.
subcategory: Trafalgar Tickets > New Theatre > What's On > Play > Murder Trial Tonight V: Death In The Family

title: Uptown Funk
description: Book your tickets to Uptown Funk at New Theatre Cardiff at the official Trafalgar Tickets, New Theatre Cardiff box office.
shortDescription:
Following Bruno Mars’ phenomenal Wembley Stadium run, selling more than half a million tickets, Uptown Funk brings the sound, style and swagger of one of the world’s biggest artists to the stage.

Fronted by the UK’s leading Bruno Mars tribute artist and backed by an incredible live band, sensational singers and slick dancers, this is a full-scale concert experience packed with energy, musicianship and nonstop hits.

Get ready for 24K Magic, Treasure, Locked Out of Heaven, That’s What I Like, Grenade, Marry You, Just the Way You Are, The Lazy Song, Silk Sonic’s Leave the Door Open, the latest hit I Just Might and, of course, the unstoppable Uptown Funk.

Expect huge vocals, sharp choreography, dazzling production and all the feel-good energy of a Bruno Mars stadium show.  Don’t believe us? Just watch.
subcategory: Trafalgar Tickets > New Theatre > What's On > Music > Uptown Funk

title: Let The Music Play: THE LEGEND OF BARRY WHITE
description: Book your tickets to Let The Music Play: THE LEGEND OF BARRY WHITE at New Theatre Cardiff at the official Trafalgar Tickets, New Theatre Cardiff box office.
shortDescription: The only UK touring show dedicated to the maestro and legend, Barry White.  Direct from the USA, a critically acclaimed revue starring the incredible vocalist William Hicks also known as “the big man with the big voice”  100 million records sold, 20 gold and 10 platinum singles – the world loves Barry White and Barry White loved the world.  You’re the First, the Last, My Everything; Can’t Get Enough of Your Love, Babe; You See the Trouble with Me; Never, Never Gonna Give You Up; Just the Way You Are; What Am I Gonna Do With You and, of course, Let the Music Play... you’re never more than a song away from another million-selling hit.  Hailing from Atlanta Georgia, William’s mesmerising stage presence effortlessly recreates the distinctive style and silky-smooth bass-baritone vocals of the three-time Grammy Award-winner.  Joined on stage by his live band, Soul Unlimited and supported by the stunning Motown Supreme Dreamgirls – with incredible attention to detail, this show has really “got it together” with William coming “as close to the real man himself as is possible.”  “William’s vocal and deliverance is phenomenal, and this show is simply stunning” Eddie Holland (Motown Legendary Songwriter Holland-Dozier-Holland)  If you love Soul and Motown -book your seats now!  Let the Music Play!

title: T.Rextasy
description: Book your tickets to T.Rextasy  at New Theatre Cardiff at the official Trafalgar Tickets, New Theatre Cardiff box office.
shortDescription:
Marc Bolan, with his band T.Rex, was one of the most flamboyant and charismatic stars of the original glam rock era.  With Bolan's special ingredient of Rock-a-Boogie songs, the band had a string of huge hits throughout the 1970s including Get it On, Telegram Sam, Jeepster and 20th Century Boy. 

This year T.Rextasy will be commemorating the tragic loss of this truly iconic Glam Rock Superstar in 1977 

T.Rextasy have now been performing around the world for over 20 years, a career that ironically out lives Marc’s very own T.Rex.  The band is now accepted as the world’s only official live tribute band dedicated to Marc Bolan & T.Rex, and the only band endorsed and approved by Marc Bolan’s family, estate, original ex-members of T.Rex, and Bolan’s catalogue management.  The band has been described by many as ‘beyond the boundaries of tribute’. 

Truly a rock’n’roll concert for all ages - If you would like to know exactly what a Marc Bolan concert was like in the 1970s, this show is for you!
subcategory: Trafalgar Tickets > New Theatre > What's On > Music > T.Rextasy

title: The Illegal Eagles - Their Greatest Hits Tour 2027
description: Book your tickets to The Illegal Eagles - Their Greatest Hits Tour 2027  at New Theatre Cardiff at the official Trafalgar Tickets, New Theatre Cardiff box office.
shortDescription:
The Illegal Eagles return in 2027 with their brand new ‘Their Greatest Hits’ Tour, celebrating the legendary Eagles album Their Greatest Hits (1971–1975) - the record that became the first album ever to achieve quadruple platinum status and remains one of the biggest-selling albums of all time. 

For this special tour, audiences will experience the iconic album performed in its entirety, bringing timeless songs such as Take It Easy, Lyin’ Eyes, One of These Nights, and Desperado to life on stage. 

Alongside the full album performance, the show features favourites from across the Eagles’ remarkable catalogue, including Hotel California, Life in the Fast Lane, and many more. 

With decades of experience, exceptional musicianship, and a deep love for this legendary music, The Illegal Eagles deliver a stunning live concert experience. It’s an unforgettable evening of nostalgia and pure musical magic that continues to captivate fans old and new.
subcategory: Trafalgar Tickets > New Theatre > What's On > Music > The Illegal Eagles - Their Greatest Hits Tour 2027

We’re Lovin’ It, Lovin’ It, Lovin’ It, We’re Lovin’ It Lycett  Joe Lycett is back and he is unleashed! He was leashed! Now the leash has been removed, so there is no leash! title: Singin' In The Rain
description: Book your tickets to Singin' In The Rain at New Theatre Cardiff at the official Trafalgar Tickets, New Theatre Cardiff box office.
shortDescription: Jonathan Church Theatre Productions presents The Chichester Festival Theatre, Stage Entertainment and Sheffield Theatres production of Singin’ in the Rain, based on the classic Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer film. Screenplay by Betty Comden and Adolph Green. Songs by Nacio Herb Brown and Arthur Freed. Performed by arrangement with Music Theatre International.  A smash-hit in the West End and across the UK, this irresistibly charming show comes to the New Theatre Cardiff to make a splash in August 2027!  Journey back to the glamour of Hollywood in the roaring 20’s with high-energy choreography and sumptuous set designs (including over 14,000 litres of water on stage), combined with all the romance and wit of one of the world’s best- loved films.  Beautiful, charismatic, and very much in love (if you believe what you read in the press), Hollywood’s golden couple, Don Lockwood and Lina Lamont have the world at their feet. But when “talkies” start to replace silent movies, and an aspiring actress is drafted in to save the day, life as they know it is turned upside down.  Singin’ in the Rain features the glorious MGM score including Good Morning, Make ‘em Laugh and the legendary Singin’ in the Rain.  Don’t save it for a rainy day, book your tickets now!
subcategory: Trafalgar Tickets > New Theatre > What's On > Musical > Singin' In The Rain

title: My Royal Life: An Audience With Lucy Worsley
description: Book your tickets to My Royal Life: An Audience With Lucy Worsley at New Theatre Cardiff at the official Trafalgar Tickets, New Theatre Cardiff box office.
shortDescription: Step into a glittering royal world with Lucy Worsley, beloved historian and bestselling author, who spent twenty years working as Chief Curator in some of Britain’s most marvellous palaces.  Lucy wants to take you behind the scenes and into the history of the royal residences she came to know so well, from Hampton Court’s Haunted Gallery, to the gilded apartments of Kensington Palace. Along the way, we’ll meet some of Britain’s best-known queens and kings, and find out what Lucy really thinks of them. With her trademark warmth and scholarly sparkle, this evening will lift the lid on royal life over the centuries, introducing you to its pageantry and – sometimes – its pain. Prepare to be entertained, enlightened, and thoroughly charmed as Lucy reveals the secrets, stories, and splendours of Britain’s royal past.
subcategory: Trafalgar Tickets > New Theatre > What's On > Special Events > My Royal Life: An Audience With Lucy Worsley

title: The Simon & Garfunkel Story
description: Book your tickets to The Simon & Garfunkel Story at New Theatre Cardiff at the official Trafalgar Tickets, New Theatre Cardiff box office.
shortDescription: Few shows have experienced the phenomenal global success of The Simon & Garfunkel Story, with multiple sold-out shows in over 50-countries worldwide and over 20 headline performances in London’s West End, including multiple appearances at the world-famous London Palladium.  Using huge projection photos and original film footage, the international hit show tells the story of the origins and meteoric rise of Simon & Garfunkel blended together seamlessly with a full live band performing all the hits including Mrs Robinson, Cecilia, Bridge Over Troubled Water, Homeward Bound and many more.  With standing ovations at every performance at the show Art Garfunkel himself loved, you don't want to miss this international sensation.
subcategory: Trafalgar Tickets > New Theatre > What's On > Music > The Simon & Garfunkel Story

title: Charlotte Church’s End Times Pop Dungeon
description: For over a decade, Charlotte Church’s Late Night Pop Dungeon has been one of the most fiercely original live experiences in Britain. Part euphoric rave, part sacred ceremony, part total Dadaist carnage, it has become the stuff of festival legend. Now it returns, reborn and recharged, for one final chapter. End Times Pop Dungeon: The Evolution Will Not Be Televised. This is the Pop Dungeon at its most apocalyptic. Riffs that could level a city. Voices that belong somewhere celestial. And Charlotte Fucking Church leading the whole beautiful chaos from the front. Their collage-as-concert has always moved people somewhere else entirely, and this tour is no different. It is a transportation. It is a transformation. And it’s coming to Depot. ➡️ Pre-Sale: 10am, Thursday, 18th June ➡️ General Sale: 10am, Friday 19th June

title: I Prevail – The Violent Nature Tour
description: Grammy-nominated metalcore heavyweights I Prevail bring The Violent Nature Tour to DEPOT Cardiff this September, following phenomenal demand across the UK. This extra Cardiff date promises an intense, full-throttle night as the band showcase tracks from their explosive new album Violent Nature alongside fan favourites from Lifelines, TRAUMA and TRUE POWER. Formed in Metro Detroit in 2013, I Prevail have grown from underground hopefuls to one of modern heavy music’s most powerful live acts, earning gold-certified records on both sides of the Atlantic and a Grammy nomination for Best Rock Album along the way. Violent Nature pushes them even further, channelling personal conflict and raw emotion into some of their heaviest, most cathartic songs to date – from the ferocious title track to the huge, melodic hooks of “Rain”. Joining them in Cardiff are special guests Polaris, and Gore. setting the tone with a stacked bill of crushing riffs, soaring choruses and big, emotional singalongs from start to finish. Expect a high-energy, no-compromise show from a band entering a new era – louder, darker and more ambitious than ever.
shortDescription: I Prevail bring The Violent Nature Tour to DEPOT Cardiff with special guests Polaris and Gore for a huge night of modern heavy music.

title: Autechre – Live
description: Following a run of sold-out shows throughout 2025, Autechre return in 2026 with an expanded run of live dates. Sean Booth and Rob Brown will head from Japan in February into a major European stretch across September and October — including their biggest headline show to date in London — before landing in Cardiff this October. Autechre’s live shows are unlike anything else: full immersion, complete focus, and a performance delivered entirely in darkness. This is a rare chance to experience one of electronic music’s most influential and uncompromising acts in their purest form. 🎟️ Tickets ➡ Presale live Wednesday 3rd December, 11am ➡ General sale Thursday 4th December, 11am DISCLAIMER: Autechre will perform in total darkness. For their set all lights in the venue will be off and the bars will be closed if they are in the room where Autechre perform. Please plan on being in one place for the performance and do not move unnecessarily until it has finished when the lights will come back on again. Please do not shine any lights at the stage or around the room during the performance. If you need to leave for any reason please use your mobile phone to light your way. Absolutely no recording or flash photography please. If you are uncomfortable with the idea of spending around one hour in the dark while Autechre play please do not book a ticket for this concert. Thanks and enjoy the experience, Autechre

title: Shang Presents: Duke Dumont
description: Fifteen years ago, Duke Dumont played his first headline show for Shangri-La in Cardiff. Now he’s back — and this time he’s bringing everything with him. Since that first show, Dumont has built one of the most uncompromising careers in electronic music. UK #1 singles. A cult-favourite DJ series in For Club Play Only. A 2022 Coachella set that announced him as a genuine live force. And a debut album that proved there was far more to him than the dancefloor — though the dancefloor has always been where it matters most. His latest album Union is the clearest statement of intent yet. Designed to be heard in full, in a room, with a crowd — not shuffled on a playlist. Every track built for the live experience, including euphoric anthem The Chant, which has become a centrepiece of his acclaimed live show. title: PRESIDENT — Blood of Your Empire
description: Multi-million streaming UK collective PRESIDENT bring their headline campaign to Depot this November, in support of their debut full-length Blood of Your Empire, out September 4 via Atlantic Records. Built on mystery, intent, and a refusal to conform, PRESIDENT have carved out a space entirely their own — sitting at the crossroads of heavy music, electronic experimentation, and cinematic atmosphere. Since launching in 2025, they’ve cultivated a devoted following through a string of singles and live performances, letting the music do the talking. Blood of Your Empire is a bold and unflinching debut — a record born from frontman President’s own reckoning with existential crisis, faith, mortality, and the long, complicated shadow religion has cast across human history. It’s an album that lives in contradiction: the compassion and the bloodshed, the beauty and the ruin. Lead single DOOMLOOP sets the tone — a meditation on time, presence, and the cost of sleepwalking through your own life. The album artwork is taken from The Battle of Poitiers by Eugène Delacroix — a painting that hangs in the Louvre — a fittingly grand and visceral image for a record of this scope. Fresh from a sold-out US run supporting Bad Omens, PRESIDENT return home to headline. Don’t miss them at Depot on 18 November. 🎟️ General On-Sale: Friday 29th May, 10am
shortDescription: PRESIDENT bring their Blood of Your Empire UK Tour to Depot, Cardiff. Heavy music, cinematic atmosphere. Don't miss out!

title: Avatar — Don’t Go In The Forest ’26
description: Swedish theatrical metal titans Avatar bring their Don’t Go In The Forest ’26 headline European tour to Depot Cardiff on Saturday 22nd November, with special guests Neckbreakker. Hot on the heels of a monumental summer — which includes a run of dates supporting Metallica across Europe (including London Stadium on 5th July) and headline slots at some of the continent’s biggest festivals — Avatar round out 2026 on their own terms, plunging Europe Out of the Shadows… Into the Dark. Avatar have spent two decades honing one of live music’s most visceral and unforgettable experiences: a collision of unrelenting heavy metal and theatrical spectacle that has made them a must-see act at every stage they’ve graced. Their latest album Don’t Go In The Forest is out now. Supporting on all dates are Danish death metal outfit Neckbreakker.

title: Little Angels – Big Bad & Back Tour
description: Legendary UK hard rock band Little Angels are Big, Bad & Back — returning with an ultra-rare UK tour featuring the full original line-up. Formed nearly 40 years ago in Scarborough, Little Angels became one of the defining British rock bands of the late ’80s and early ’90s, building a fiercely loyal fanbase and scoring 11 UK Top 40 singles along the way. Their 1993 album Jam hit #1, cementing their place at the top of the UK rock scene. The last time the band toured was in 2012, following their triumphant return at Download Festival. Before that? A sold-out farewell show at London’s Royal Albert Hall in 1994. Now, for the first time in over a decade, Toby Jepson, Bruce Dickinson, Jim Dickinson, Mark Plunkett and Mark Richardson reunite for a proper return — not a nostalgia cash-in, but a celebration of an era, a scene, and a band that helped define it. Joining them as special guest on all dates is long-time friend and Thunder guitarist Luke Morley, making this a night firmly rooted in one of the most iconic periods of UK hard rock. 🎟️ TICKETS On sale 18 February at 9am
shortDescription: Little Angels bring their ultra-rare Big Bad & Back Tour to DEPOT in November. Full original line-up. Support from Luke Morley (Thunder)

title: Midge Ure – A Man Of Two Worlds
description: Acclaimed musician, producer, and Ultravox frontman Midge Ure brings his visionary A Man Of Two Worlds Tour to DEPOT, Cardiff on 25 November 2026. This bold new live concept offers fans a rare and deeply personal concert experience. For the first time, Ure will blend his iconic hits and fan favourites with the atmospheric instrumentals that have long featured on his solo albums — many of which have never been performed live. The result is a rich show designed to take the audience on an emotional journey, both visually and sonically. From his early days with Slik and The Rich Kids, to defining the sound of the ’80s with Ultravox and co-creating the global charity single Do They Know It’s Christmas?, Midge Ure has always challenged musical expectations. With Ivor Novello, Grammy and BASCAP awards to his name, he continues to push boundaries with this ambitious new show. Don’t miss the chance to experience a truly unique evening of music that bridges decades of creativity — a live set not just performed, but curated, woven together into an unforgettable narrative. title: James B Partridge presents The Big Christmas Assembly
description: Join James B Partridge for The Big Christmas Assembly 2026 – the nostalgic, feel-good festive singalong that brings your childhood Christmases flooding back. Packed with more festive classics, throwback mashups, and laugh-out-loud stories than you can throw a glitter-glue halo at. What began as playful performances for his pupils has grown into a nationwide phenomenon – from TikTok fame to closing the field at Glastonbury Festival. With recent appearances on Virgin Radio, BBC Radio 2, The One Show and Songs of Praise, James has never been more in demand – and with the majority of his 2025 Christmas tour selling out well in advance, early booking is strongly advised. Whether you’re organising the work Christmas party, planning that festive night out with friends, or simply treating yourself to the perfect pre-Christmas warm-up – this is guaranteed to get you, and everyone around you, well and truly in the spirit. Mulled wine in hand, the whole room singing Calypso Carol like it’s the last day of term – the kind of communal magic that lingers all the way to Boxing Day. James says: “I’ve always loved how the songs we sang as children at Christmas brought so much joy. This show is a celebration of those moments – from assembly halls to nativity plays – and I can’t wait to see audiences relive them together.”
shortDescription: The nostalgic, feel-good festive singalong packed with more Christmas classics & throwback mashups than you can throw a glitter-glue halo.

description: After over a decade of music and touring, The Hunna announce their final tour. 2026 will be the final chance to see the band in action and the band themselves are extremely excited to share one last big party with their ever dedicated fan base. “We’re all incredibly proud of what this band and its music has meant for so many people around the world, it’s been an unforgettable ride!”. “It’s been our whole lives since teenagers and at this point it feels like the right time for us to naturally move onto new chapters”. – Ryan 2026 marks the 10 year anniversary of the bands debut album and fan favourite “100” and the band have said it feels like a full circle moment to end it here. The Hunna will be celebrating “100” alongside other favourites from the rest of their catalogue on this final tour. AEG Presents in association with ITB 🎟️ On sale: Friday 24 July, 10am

description: Celebrate the festive season with a full-blown Nashville party as One Night In Nashville: A Very Country Christmas lands at DEPOT. Bringing the UK’s leading honky-tonk experience to the warehouse, this high-energy live show delivers the biggest modern country hits alongside timeless classics — all wrapped in a Christmas twist. Expect a packed set featuring music made famous by the likes of Shania Twain, Luke Combs, Carrie Underwood, Taylor Swift and Chris Stapleton, plus iconic tributes to legends including Dolly Parton, Johnny Cash and Kenny Rogers. Fronted by UK country star Maria Jordan and backed by a powerhouse live band, the show transports you straight to downtown Nashville with big vocals, standout musicianship and wall-to-wall singalongs. Whether you’re in it for the classics, the modern hits or just a big festive night out, expect a feel-good atmosphere, hands-in-the-air moments and a proper Christmas party with a country edge. This is Nashville, DEPOT style. One night only. TICKETS ➡️ On sale Monday, 20 April at 10am SIGN UP FOR TICKETS

title: Fontaines D.C. at Blackweir
description: Following headline shows at Reading and Leeds festivals, Fontaines D.C. have announced a huge Welsh show at Blackweir, with support from Little Simz and Viagra Boys. The band will follow in the footsteps of the likes of The Cure, Stevie Wonder, Alanis Morissette, Slayer and Lewis Capaldi as headliners at the iconic new music series in the Welsh capital. The news follows the recent announcement of Fontaines D.C.’s fifth studio album, Dopamine Chamber, released on 16th October via XL Recordings. Produced by James Ford, it’s the follow-up to 2024’s UK platinum-certified Romance — the sound of a band moving decisively away from the guitar language of their early records and into their most seductive music yet. Preceded by lead single “Marianne”, the album asks how pleasure mutates amid peril, and what our pursuit of it reveals about us. “The album itself is a dopamine chamber,” says Chatten. “You step inside and we test these different mind- or mood-altering pieces of music on you.” From Dogrel (2019) to the anarchic, kaleidoscopic Romance (2024), Fontaines D.C. have spent five albums refusing to repeat themselves — and Dopamine Chamber is their most radical turn yet. 🎟 Tickets Presale opens Wednesday 9 September, 10AM General sale from Thursday 10 September, 10AM SIGN UP FOR PRESALE ACCESS
shortDescription: Fontaines D.C. return to Cardiff for a huge show summer show at Blackweir. Support from Little Simz and Viagra Boys.

title: The Dualers
description: The Dualers – Britain’s finest Ska & Reggae band – are bringing their legendary live show to Depot, for one unforgettable night. The 9-piece South-East London outfit first broke through with their chart hit Kiss on the Lips, and have since sold out arenas and theatres across the UK, Europe and Asia, including record-breaking runs at London’s O2 Indigo and headline shows at Wembley Arena and Manchester Apollo. Now, with new music from their hotly anticipated album Beach Life, The Dualers are back on tour – ready to deliver their unique blend of Jamaican Rhythm & Blues, Ska and Reggae to the Tiger Yard stage. Expect an electric atmosphere, unstoppable dancing, and all the feel-good energy that has made The Dualers a must-see live act.

description: 10cc founding member Graham Gouldman has announced an 18-date UK tour in 2026 for his highly acclaimed semi-acoustic band Heart Full of Songs. Featuring material from across Gouldman’s catalogue, the set includes 10cc classics I’m Not In Love and Dreadlock Holiday, alongside hits such as Bus Stop and Look Through Any Window (The Hollies), For Your Love and Heart Full of Soul (The Yardbirds), No Milk Today (Herman’s Hermits), Bridge To Your Heart (from his time in Wax with the late Andrew Gold), film soundtracks and songs from his solo albums.

title: THIS FLIGHT TONIGHT - THE SONGS OF JONI MITCHELL
description: An intimate acoustic tribute to the music of JONI MITCHELL, With a full and comprehensive performance of Joni's most beloved album 'Blue' in its entirety. 'Blue' is regarded by audiences and critics as one of the greatest albums of all time. Mitchell's honesty, musical prowess and iconic voice invites the audience into Joni's experience of living and loving through the complex era of social change of the early 1970s. 'Blue' highlights the fallout of a decade of hedonism... 'A Case of You', a stunning declaration of intoxicating love. 'Little Green' Arguably one of Joni's most personal and brave songs. 'California', 'Carey', carefree love letters to Joni's travels and freedom.
shortDescription: Buy tickets and see event information for This Flight Tonight - The songs of Joni Mitchell.

title: FANNA-FI-ALLAH SUFI QAWWALI
description: Now in their 26th year of international touring, Fanna-Fi-Allah remains one of the foremost traditional Qawwali ensembles in the world today. With thousands of performances across 50+ countries, they carry the living spirit of Sufi shrine music to global audiences, offering a rare and powerful immersion into this devotional art form. Led by Tahir Qawwal and supported by a masterful ensemble of tabla, harmonium, and choral vocals, the group stays rooted in the classical Qawwali tradition—without fusion, electronics, or pop crossover.
shortDescription: Buy tickets and see event information for Fanna-Fi-Allah Sufi Qawwali.

title: GRAHAM PARKER
description: Celebrating the 50th anniversary of the classic albums Howlin' Wind and Heat Treatment. Slinging his signature guitar and singing with inimitable soulful grit, Graham Parker has spent more than four decades carving out a singular place in rock and roll. A critics’ favorite and a songwriter’s songwriter, he emerged in the mid-1970s at a pivotal moment in British music. With his band The Rumour, Parker released a run of essential albums including Howlin’ Wind, Heat Treatment, and the undisputed classic Squeezing Out Sparks, records that fused literate songwriting with the raw energy that helped reshape rock in the late seventies.
shortDescription: Buy tickets and see event information for Graham Parker.

title: TOBY LEE
description: Toby Lee announces his 3rd UK headline tour with his brilliant band. They’ll be heading out for 18 shows in October & November this year. title: GRACE PETRIE
description: For a decade and a half, Grace Petrie has been one of the UK’s most urgent and passionate songwriters. Coming of age amidst the coalition government, her politically charged folk music quickly gained national attention and propelled her to the main stages of folk festivals from Cambridge to Vancouver to the Blue Mountains of Australia. Characterised by razor-sharp lyricism and the unmistakable passion of her stage presence, her live shows have become synonymous for fans with a unique atmosphere of hope and solidarity, while the LGBTQ anthem Black Tie has racked up 1.5 million streams and provided the soundtrack of expression for young queer folks all over the world.
shortDescription: Buy tickets and see event information for Grace Petrie.

title: TENILLE TOWNES
description: Known for songs that illuminate the inner lives of others, singer-songwriter Tenille Townes Townes now enters a new chapter with The Acrobat, her forthcoming album due April 10, 2026. Written during a period of personal and professional transition, the record marks her most stripped-back and introspective work to date. Originally conceived as simple work tapes, the songs were written and recorded in solitude, capturing raw moments of uncertainty, resilience, and self-reclamation. Tenille Townes is a Canada-born, Nashville-based artist whose music centers on empathy, honesty, and emotional clarity. Over the past five years, her deeply human storytelling has earned her two JUNO Awards, two Academy of Country Music Awards, and 17 Canadian Country Music Association Awards, alongside tours with artists like Stevie Nicks, Miranda Lambert, Shania Twain, Keith Urban, Reba, and George Strait. With The Acrobat, Townes embraces imperfection and autonomy, offering songs that hold space for change, boundaries, and the courage it takes to choose yourself.
shortDescription: Buy tickets and see event information for Tenille Townes .

title: THE COURETTES
description: The Courettes is an explosive Wall of Sound group from Denmark and Brazil! Flavia Couri on vocals and guitar, Martin on loud drums and together they are the perfect blend of Wall of Sound, Girl Group Heartbreaks, Motown and R&B. Imagine The Ronettes meeting The Ramones at a wild party at the Hitsville echo chamber! The new album “The Soul Of The Fabulous Courettes” is out on legendary Damaged Goods Records, London and Rough Trade, London.

title: DEVIN TOWNSEND
description: Forging a career over four decades in countless genres, Devin Townsend has reached cult status in the progressive-metal world for his polymathic talent and continual pushing of the envelope. In 2025, after a career including iconic performances at Royal Albert Hall and multiple world tours, Townsend announced an indefinite hiatus from touring. Having then delivered the live debut in Groningen of ‘The Moth’, his most ambitious work to date, it was only natural to need a break. Townsend returned home to complete the studio album of ‘The Moth’ (out 29th May on InsideOut Music) and to rebuild himself in preparation for the next stage.
shortDescription: Buy tickets and see event information for Devin Townsend.

title: SEVEN WONDERS - THE SPIRIT OF FLEETWOOD MAC
description: Seven Wonders are a 7-piece, 100% live band, who have come together to pay tribute to the legacy of Fleetwood Mac. The band cover all eras of the Fleetwood Mac collection; from the timeless Peter Green years, through to the 80’s classic Tango in the night. Seven Wonders capture the Spirit of Fleetwood Mac and they do it with passion and appreciation for this classic band. Be prepared to sing and dance the night away to classics including: Go your own way, Don’t stop, The Chain, Everywhere, Rhiannon, Dreams, Little lies, Oh well, Edge of seventeen and many more….. “I didn’t expect to feel like I was watching Fleetwood Mac….amazing vocals and band” “Absolutely fantastic band, The best tribute I’ve ever seen” “If you get a chance to see them ,100% you won’t be disappointed”

title: CAITLIN MORAN: HOW TO BE HOPEFUL
description: Caitlin Moran is the eldest of eight children, home-educated on a council estate in Wolverhampton. She published her first novel at 16 and became a columnist at The Times at 18. She has won Columnist of the Year seven times and has also been named Interviewer and Critic of the Year. Her million-selling, groundbreaking feminist memoir, How to Be a Woman, was voted one of the Sunday Times’ ‘Most Important Books of the Twenty-First Century’. She lives in North London with her husband and two children, and, after following all her own advice, she really is hopeful now.
