title: NICK HEYWARD THE 12 DATES OF CHRISTMAS
description: Nick Heyward has announced a brand-new UK tour for winter 2026, The 12 Dates of Christmas — a unique run of intimate performances set in some of the country’s most beautiful and atmospheric venues. The 12-date UK tour will kick off on 14th November at Lincoln Cathedral and will see Heyward perform across historic churches and cathedrals, creating a special live experience that blends his much-loved catalogue with a festive, acoustic feel. Best known as the frontman of Haircut 100, Heyward continues to build on a remarkable legacy, with the band’s long-awaited follow-up to Pelican West – Boxing The Compass – set for release on 19 June 2026, marking an exciting new chapter for the band. Heyward is also currently working on new solo material, with more details on this exciting project to follow.

Very excited for this one! It’s so nice to do the intimate shows and add a few Christmas songs in too!”Catherine Thomas

title: NICKO MCBRAIN - AN EVENING IN CONVERSATION WITH
description: Following the recent announcement of Hello Boys and Girls!, Nicko McBrain’s thrilling, hilarious and deeply personal autobiography which will be published on 22nd October 2026, the much-loved drummer will now be taking to the road on a spoken word tour. Starting in Frankfurt on October 26th, Nicko McBrain will be visiting theatres across Germany, Netherlands, Scandinavia, Ireland and the UK, regaling audiences with colourful stories of a life well-lived. Featuring tales from behind the drum-stool of one of Britain’s biggest ever bands, alongside lessons learned from his eventful youth, his triumphant highs and deepest lows, this is a chance for fans to get up-close-and-personal with one of the most famous and admired men in rock history.

title: RÍOGHNACH CONNOLLY & HONEYFEET
description: Ríoghnach Connolly & Honeyfeet move with ease and confidence between swampy jazz, raucous brass, fractured funk, blues balladry, and gorgeous folkloric textures. Connolly’s powerhouse vocals lead the charge, blending mischief, protest and vulnerability into something fiercely human and utterly live. Honeyfeet holds all of this together with a groove and a commitment to musical freedom. The lineup consists of Lorien Garth Edwards on bass, Ellis Davies on guitar, John Ellis on keyboards, Biff Roxby on brass, and Phill Howley on drums form a fluid and fearless musical unit.

title: JOSIE LONG & ROBIN INCE: 20 YEARS OF SHAMBLES
description: For twenty years, Robin Ince and Josie Long have been performing and making things together. Now, after two decades of friendship, creativity and comedy, they are coming together for a special tour celebrating curiosity, collaboration and the joy of finding wonder in unexpected places. Expect a joyfully unpredictable evening of stand-up, poetry, conversation, (plenty of) digressions and whatever else emerges when two endlessly curious minds share a stage.

title: MELIN MELYN
description: Cardiff Music City Festival in partnership with Horizons/Gorwelion and Beacons Cymru present: Melin Melyn. They are more than just a band. They’re world-builders; storytellers absorbing various elements of the increasingly strange times around us and using them to create fables that ruminate on grief, love, and hope. Their debut album Mill On The Hill sees the band jump between surf-rock, country, prog-rock and psychedelia with the grace and skill of a band with numerous records under their belt, held together by an efficacious and fantastical thematic principle. Melin Melyn translates to ‘Yellow Mill’ in Welsh, and on this album the Welsh six-piece invite the audience into the world they have quite literally built around them. Mill On The Hill transports the listeners to the utopian ‘Melin Village’, a Seussian world where townsfolk “bask in the beauty of song.” Support comes from MORN who emerged from the farmlands of Monmouth, South Wales. Two sets of siblings crafting a compelling blend of what they refer to as “doom over beautiful chords.” Announcing their arrival with the breathless, runaway train chaoticism of ‘Modern Man’, MORN weave spiky guitar passages and rumbling fuzz, with an urgency that feels as though they can’t get to the end of the song fast enough. The line up is completed with Internet Fatigue, Betsan and Farai KD
support: with Morn + Internet Fatigue + Betsan + Farai KD

title: PLAYBACK AFTER HOURS – MEDIA CYMRU X CULTVR CHALLENGE FUND
description:
PLAYBACK After Hours at CULTVR
Awkward Studios, Mark Eaglen and Noelle Nurdin, Owain Llwyd & Peredur Glyn will showcase their R&D outcomes from the Media Cymru × CULTVR Immersive Challenge Fund at PLAYBACK After Hours at CULTVR on Wednesday 16 September.
Programme: Wednesday 16 September 2026
5.30pm Doors Open
6.20pm Welcome and introductions
6:30–7:00pm Mark Eaglen – EchoSystem
7:30–8:00pm Awkward Studios – Game of Domes
8:30–9:00pm Noelle Nurdin, Owain Llwyd and Peredur Webb-Davies – Lost in Light
9:00–9:30pm Closing networking, and future-opportunity conversations
Book your free ticket to attend the event.
The bar will be open from 5:30pm–9:30pm, with a food truck on site throughout the evening.
Awkward Studios
GAME OF DOMES explores whether immersive dome environments can serve as low-cost, rapid testing grounds for quiz and gameshow IP. Awkward Studios is piloting an original immersive experience – building and testing television gameshow mechanics inside CULTVR’s 360º dome. Through their R&D, they hope to discover that domes don’t just offer a new venue for live entertainment – they give the TV production industry a faster, cheaper route from format idea to commissioned series and further licensing opportunities for existing quiz & game IP.
Mark Eaglen
Echosystem investigates ideas of emergence by placing audience interactions as central to the experience. The project explores a responsive environment of sensor stations, each one offering an invitation to play. Interactions ripple through a hybrid world of XR visuals, spatial soundscapes and sculptural interfaces, coalescing towards a space that feels alive; a pan-dimensional playground of collaboration between artist and audience.
Noelle Nurdin, Owain Llwyd & Peredur Glyn
Lost in Light / Ar Goll yn y Golau is a shared fulldome immersive experience combining Welsh legends, dark-sky data, live ensemble performance and motion-reactive spatial audio. Audiences co-create an evolving soundscape as part of an interactive narrative that explores light pollution, cultural heritage, and human connection in CULTVR’s dome and Eryri National Park Authority.
About PLAYBACK
PLAYBACK is Media Cymru’s festival of innovation taking place in Cardiff on 15, 16 and 17 September 2026. The festival consists of a one-day research conference at Cardiff University’s School of Journalism on 15 September, followed by two days of talks, panels and experiences, on 16 and 17 September, showcasing the incredible work from across the Media Cymru programme. Taking place at Tramshed, Tramshed Tech and fringe venues across the city. For programme updates and to book free tickets to PLAYBACK, visit Media Cymru’s website: https://media.cymru/playback/
About Media Cymru × CULTVR Immersive Challenge Fund 
The Media Cymru × CULTVR Immersive Challenge Fund focused on immersive innovation to support experimentation and capacity-building within the Welsh media sector, supporting the development of new content. The fund invested in four ambitious projects exploring new approaches to immersive storytelling and audience engagement using XR technologies. Find out more about all the projects: https://media.cymru/media-cymru-and-cultvr-invest-in-shared-immersive-experiences-with-four-new-rd-projects-2/

title: MINDSET BY NATALIE ROE & BETH LEWIS – LIVE IMMERSIVE PERFORMANCE
description:
MINDSET is an immersive concert combining Natalie Roe’s surround acoustic and electronic music with Beth Lewis’ vibrant 3D motion visuals. The performance explores the concept of mindset; ‘the established set of attitudes held by someone’ through a dynamic journey of emotional states and musical styles.
Rooted in live performance, the piece features live modular synthesiser spatialised in real-time and elements of live visual manipulation, bringing both risk and immediacy to the experience. Originally created for the Dora Stoutzker Hall at the Royal Welsh College of Music & Drama, MINDSET now evolves within CULTVR’s fully immersive environment, expanding its sensory impact.
This new iteration reflects five years of artistic development, with Natalie Roe and Beth Lewis reworking the music and visuals to relaunch the project and adapt it to site-specific spaces.
Natalie Roe – Modular Synthesiser, Electronic Instruments, Piano, Flute
Beth Lewis – Visuals, live spatialisation of sound
18th of September 2026

title: CELYN OF GWENT / LIVE PERFORMANCE
description:
Dying and Rising by Celyn of Gwent is a live solo immersive audiovisual performance combining electronic music, ethereal live voice, sound-reactive visuals and poetic monologues. The work is being newly adapted for fulldome presentation, expanding from its original format into a fully immersive spatial environment.
‘We will have no puff of smoke and bloodless resurrection.
We must tend a different garden from the poisoned soil.’
Rooted in an urgent artistic response to the climate crisis, the piece explores the intersection of ecology and identity in contemporary Britain through the perspective of a queer Welsh sonic artist and storyteller. It weaves together original songs, reinterpretations of traditional British Isles ballads, spoken word, and layered soundscapes incorporating urban field recordings.
Performed live, Dying and Rising integrates real-time electronic manipulation with a visual score created from processed footage filmed across Wales and London. The visuals are synchronised and driven through interactive software, allowing them to respond dynamically to the sonic material in performance.
The work has been developed with Mixing Engineer Helen Noir, alongside support from Help Musicians’ Next Level programme, R&D funding from Tŷ Cerdd in partnership with SHIFT Cardiff.  Dying and Rising is touring Wales and the UK with the support of Arts Council of Wales, to coincide with its Autumn 2026 studio album release.
Designed for audiences interested in boundary-pushing audiovisual performance, LGBTQ+ perspectives in contemporary art, traditional music reinterpretation and climate-conscious storytelling, Dying and Rising offers a powerful, evolving live experience where sound and image are tightly interwoven in real time.

title: WAX TAILOR / SOLO SET + VIDEO SHOW
description:
Wax Tailor / Solo Set + Video Show
With support from Napoleon Da Legend
Join us for the only chance to see Wax Tailor live in the UK this year, as he brings his special Solo Set + Video Show to the immersive surroundings of the CULTVR Dome.
Wax Tailor is one of the pioneering figures of the French independent hip-hop and electronic scene. After spending a decade developing his craft as a DJ, producer, composer and manager, he broke through internationally with the 2004 EP Lost The Way, followed by his landmark debut album Tales of the Forgotten Melodies (2005), now regarded as a classic of the genre.
Over the past two decades, Wax Tailor has built an international career with 7 studio albums, a live album recorded at the Olympia in Paris, numerous EPs and more than 600 concerts across over 50 countries, performing for more than one million spectators worldwide.
His work has earned three nominations for “Best Electronic Album” at the French Victoires de la Musique, the Independent Music Award in the United States, and the SACEM Grand Prize for Electronic Music.
Throughout his career, he has collaborated with a wide range of acclaimed artists including Sharon Jones, Ghostface Killah, Tricky, Lee Fields, Aloe Blacc, Mark Lanegan, R.A The Rugged Man, Mike Jenkins Charlie Winston, Del The Funky Homosapien, Ursula Rucker, Jennifer Charles, Elzhi… while also producing remixes for artists such as Nina Simone, Ayo and Asa.
Recognised for his cinematic sound, meticulous production and fiercely independent approach, Wax Tailor has established himself as one of the leading ambassadors of the French electronic and hip-hop scene, continuing to evolve while remaining true to his distinctive artistic identity.

title: GEORGIA RUTH / LIVE IMMERSIVE PERFORMANCE
description:
Join Georgia Ruth for a visual and musical ‘house tour’ of her forthcoming album, Uncanny Valley, where the familiar begins to feel strange, and comfort is shadowed by unease.
Her new album is rooted in her home, following a move from Aberystwyth to a quiet suburban area on the rural outskirts. Reflecting on suburbia, Georgia explores the tension between domestic comfort and a wider sense of political and emotional instability. As a mother of three, she captures this duality with clarity, tracing the fragile balance between safety and fear.
The house itself becomes central to the work. Retaining the original décor of its previous owners, it exists as a kind of time warp, both comforting and disquieting. This setting shapes the album’s visual world, with photographic artwork by Abby Poulson, creating a subtle, Lynchian atmosphere where the ordinary feels quietly surreal.
For CULTVR, Georgia Ruth presents not simply a concert, but an invitation into the space behind the songs. Sound, image and place combine to create an intimate and atmospheric encounter.
Georgia Ruth has long been a distinctive voice in Welsh music. Writing and performing in both Welsh and English, she has built a reputation for crafting emotionally rich, atmospheric work that draws on landscape, memory, and identity. Her previous albums have earned critical acclaim and multiple award nominations, establishing her as one of Wales’ most compelling contemporary artists.

title: SPECTRAL LURES BY CARLOS SERRANO / AV SHOWCASE
description:
A haunting and transformative experience, Spectral Lures challenges the line between the natural and the artificial, asking not just what we see, but how we perceive.
Spectral Lures is an experimental live audiovisual performance by Carlos Serrano that immerses audiences in a shifting space between illusion, memory and simulation. A flickering digital ghost emerges from the static of human data, infiltrating the sensory environment and transforming the architecture into a living and responsive system.
Blending real-time technologies such as Unreal Engine and TouchDesigner, the work unfolds as a 40-minute fulldome experience powered by 16.1 spatial audio. As the signal evolves, it adopts the audience itself as part of its network, blurring perception, dissolving boundaries, and redefining immersion as a psychological state.
Spectral Lures expands Serrano’s practice into a shared, collective space. Alongside the performance, the project includes an artist talk, inviting audiences to explore the creative and ethical dimensions of live XR, synthetic vision and immersive storytelling.
There will be a Q&A with the artist after the presentation of the work.

Right Hand Left Hand, Black Mantis and Homeostasis bring together three distinctive live immersive performances, transforming CULTVR’s dome into a space where music, moving image and 360° environments collide.

Right Hand Left Hand is an experimental two-piece instrumental post-rock band from Cardiff, Wales, featuring members Rhodri Viney and Andrew “Bernie” Plain. Their albums, such as Power Grab and the Welsh Music Prize-nominated Zone Rouge, were recorded and produced at Cardiff’s legendary Musicbox Studios.

Black Mantis is the immersive audiovisual project from Deri Roberts, co-founder of Slowly Rolling Camera. Developed in collaboration with 4Pi Productions, the performance combines Roberts’ cinematic, jazz-infused electronic music with bespoke 360° visuals created and art-directed by 4Pi, surrounding audiences in an evolving world of sound and image.

Homeostasis. Pierre-Luc Lecours and Ida Toninato bring together the acoustic and electronic worlds through the encounter of baritone saxophone, modular synthesizer, and real-time video generation.Influenced by the concepts of balance, ecology, and the equilibrium found in the Fibonacci sequence, they explore the intersection of nature and humanity in their second full-length performance, Homeostasis.
Homeostasis is co-presented by MUTEK, with the financial support of the Canada Council for the Arts and the Conseil des arts et des lettres du Québec.

description:
THE RIFT + THE VOYAGE OF ARKA KINARI – Immersive Films
Storytelling that moves, challenges and inspires.
Experience an evening of immersive cinema from 4Pi Productions, presenting two climate stories that bring the urgency of our changing planet to life. Featuring The Rift, winner at the New Images Festival in Paris and the acclaimed documentary The Voyage of Arka Kinari, recipient of a Special Jury Award at the Jena Fulldome Festival in Germany.

The Rift (8min)
Set against the rich and diverse landscapes of Zimbabwe, this striking dance film explores the tension, resilience and deep interconnectedness between people and the natural world in the face of climate change. Through movement, the performers embody the impact of environmental disruption, revealing the fragile yet profound bond that unites humanity and nature.

The Voyage of Arka Kinari (39 min)
Step aboard the 70-ton sailing vessel Arka Kinari, reimagined as a floating cultural platform dedicated to raising awareness of the climate crisis. Join acclaimed artists Filastine & Nova on a remarkable global journey, where music and art become tools for connection, activism, and resilience. Crossing oceans and cultures, their voyage highlights the urgent need for collective action through a shared creative language.

title: Mystery Ensemble
description:
А unique concert will take place at the mesmerising Llandaff Cathedral in the heart of Cardiff.

Step into a spellbinding neoclassical programme that leads audiences on a luminous journey through emotion and awe.

Featuring the visionary works of Hans Zimmer, Ludovico Einaudi, and Max Richter, this concert blends cinematic grandeur, minimalist clarity, and haunting melodic nuance.

Zimmer’s expansive compositions, like «Cornfield Chase» from Interstellar, conjure the vastness of space, while Einaudi’s delicate piano-driven pieces, such as «Petrichor», invite quiet reflection. Richter’s poignant «Sofa Chess» and the ethereal «Infra 4» interlace timeless restraint with contemporary texture.

Together, these composers shape a sonic cosmos — where orchestral detail meets atmospheric depth, offering listeners a chance to dwell in the infinite sounds of the universe.

Hans Zimmer, the constant collaborator in his films and one of the greatest film composers of our time, is an Oscar winner, a two-time Golden Globe winner, and a three-time Grammy winner. Zimmer’s original compositions will be reimagined for a unique ensemble of instruments that combines electronics and acoustic instruments.

Ludovico Einaudi is, without a doubt, one of the most prominent representatives of neoclassicism. But success and recognition were not easy for him.

title: The Music of Harry Potter by Mystery Ensemble
description:
The world of magical music from the famous novels of the same name by J.K. Rowling, lit by a flicker of hundreds of candles! The evening programme includes music from the unforgettable Harry Potter fantasy films, performed by the extraordinary Mystery Ensemble.

The film's soundtracks were masterfully composed by John Williams. The composer wrote the music at his mansions in Los Angeles and Tanglewood and then recorded at Abbey Road and Air Lyndhurst studios in London in September 2001. The film features many characteristic leitmotifs, most of which were repeated in the second part of the Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets franchise. The main composition, «Hedwig's Theme», is present in all films in a modified form. The soundtrack was released on October 30, 2001, on CD media.

On December 14, 2001, the soundtrack was certified gold in Canada (50,000 units) and in January 2002 in Japan (100,000 units). In 2002, John Williams was nominated for an Academy Award for Best Music for a Film but lost to Howard Shore, who wrote the compositions for another fantasy film, The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring, another fantasy film, “The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring”, music from which can also be heard at our concerts.

The album became a success, peaking at number 48 on the Billboard 200 and number two on the Top Soundtracks Chart. In the official UK charts, the album was at number 19.

title: Vivaldi Four Seasons at Christmas
description:
Enjoy an exceptional candlelit concert this Christmas in the stunning setting of Llandaff Cathedral in Cardiff. Celebrate the season with Vivaldi’s iconic masterpiece The Four Seasons, brought to life as you’ve never heard it before.

This vivid and revolutionary work captures the changing moods of the year, while a carefully chosen programme of festive favourites and classical masterpieces - including Corelli’s beloved Christmas Concerto, Pachelbel’s Canon in D, Elgar’s Nimrod, Tchaikovsky’s enchanting Sleeping Beauty Waltz and Strauss’s sparkling Blue Danube - creates the perfect soundtrack for a magical winter evening.
